exposure: Newborns with femoral fractures related to osteopenia of prematurity
Newborns with birth trauma-related femoral fractures
cohort: Newborns admitted to neonatal intensive care units (ICUs) within the province of Afyonkarahisar in Turkey over a 5-year period
finding: Cesarean delivery did not reduce the risk of birth trauma-associated femoral fractures, and there was a risk for femoral fracture in cases of emergency cesarean performed for malpresentation.
gest_age: Birth trauma-related femoral fractures: 39 weeks; Femoral fractures related with osteopenia of prematurity: 30.4 weeks
birth_weight: Birth trauma-related femoral fractures: 3.308 grams; Femoral fractures related with osteopenia of prematurity: 1256 grams
